name: cart-stress
description: Cart-focused aggressive retry stress test for METASTABLE FAILURE experiments. ONLY exercises POST /cart, which has a minimal call chain: frontend → productcatalog → cartservice → Redis. Sized to drive cartservice's CPU-limited deployment (100m) past its capacity ceiling under retry storm. 100 workers × 5 rps = 500 root rps; with 5 client retries × 4 mesh retries this generates up to ~10k cart-side attempts/sec under fault. Combined with the 2ms perTryTimeout in service-retries.yaml, this creates a self-sustaining retry storm: cart's queue depth stays high, latency stays above 2ms, every retry times out, more retries arrive — and the system can't escape even after the original fault is removed.
